statements.status_notes: CVE-2025-46392 involves uncontrolled resource consumption when parsing specially crafted configuration files. Cassandra configuration is sourced exclusively from operator-controlled files (cassandra.yaml) and is not derived from untrusted user input. An attacker would need existing write access to the configuration to trigger this path, at which point they already have administrative control of the node.
